book.name: Aposol
book.title: Aposol Gio Bobo Moro Tiriineji aposol dobe yabeko gio babuŋ.

content: Pitaji Jerusalem raru gioinere sundu miya.
Kotu kantri yoŋoji oŋuakoŋ Anuture buŋo roru sabarebuŋ, ore sunduine oi aposol eru maŋkekerisie ogopuyaŋuŋ Judia prowins sagaru goku manebuŋ.
Ore eru Pitaji Jerusalem sitio kirieru ropeme Juda sakiyaŋuŋgo Anuture moge baku ketigabi maŋyaŋuŋ kerisiebuŋ, yoŋoji mipemiriŋ eku mitebuŋ.
Mi teru iŋi ojibuŋ, “Kotu kantri ŋi Anuture mogeke so gogobi, go wamore raru yoŋoke aŋibaŋi ŋeku uqo munjaŋ nomeŋ? Oi so sagaga.”
Oŋu ojibi fuŋfuŋgaineone fuŋgaru ya fukeya, oi sosowo buruineke mitaniŋga yareru iŋi yajiya,

“Nonji Jopa sitio goku oŋga wosibe Ofonde kobiji nuko ŋeku qohoŋ iru mo iŋi ŋoneboŋ: Sombunji aŋgame ya soguine mo wakiya. Ya oi kambaŋ yagaŋine soguinere kamasi oŋuine fukeya. Mimerereŋ yoŋoji ya ore guru 4 oo roku kitiŋganobuŋ, ore kamasi oŋuine nonde maŋfuŋgo akoŋ wakiru peya.

Wakiru peko ya ore maŋineo poretiŋ ŋonebe joma fuŋne fuŋneji ŋebuŋ. Joma goine oi moreŋgo kufu 4:ji oderu raegobi. Goine rigaŋine joyaŋuŋke fukegobi. Goineji beuyaŋunji peperu raegobi. Oŋuakoŋ webo fuŋne fuŋne sowoo fururu qaru raegobi, ya oŋuine oi kambaŋ ore maŋineo moko wakibi ŋone yabeboŋ.
Ŋone yabebe buŋo mo oŋuakoŋ fukeru iŋi najime maneboŋ, ‘Pita, go pakereru ya yo qaku rigaru no.’
“Oŋu maneboŋyoŋ, nonji iŋi miboŋ, ‘O Ofoŋ, noŋ ore eru mamagiine manego. Ya sowo wuwunuŋineke oŋuine oi damaŋ mogo nonde mi bibigo so yoŋoya. Ore eru oi so yobu nobemiŋ.’
Oŋu mibe buŋo oiji moke Sombuŋgone fukeru iŋi najiya, ‘Anutuji ya miku keririkeko pega, goji ore tinaine wuwunuŋineke oŋu so miigoŋ.’
Ya oŋuine oi ateine yokaomo fukeya. Oŋu fukeme ya sosowo oi moke porebi Sombuŋgo kirieru ropeya.
Roperu pikamaŋgaru damaŋ oo akoŋ Korniliusji Sisaria taoŋgone ŋi yokaomo sore yabeme nondeo warebuŋ, yoŋoji pi ŋebeŋ, ore mendigo dimabuŋ.

“Mendigo dimakabi Moro Tiriineji iŋi mitiga nareme maneboŋ, ‘Go maŋyoka etaŋqataŋ yoberu yoŋoke raigoŋ.’ Buŋo oi manebe maŋkekerisie ogopune 6 yoŋoji oŋuakoŋ Jopa bokeru noke Sisaria taoŋgo rabeŋ. Sisaria roperu mamari siŋaŋ iŋore pigo ropebeneŋ.
Ropekabeneŋ buŋo binaŋ iŋi ba noreya, ‘Mimerereŋ moji nonde pigo fukeko ŋonebe dimaku iŋi najiya: Go Jopa kaeo kiŋaŋ ruaru ŋi tinaine Saimon, tinaine mo Pita oi ogaru wareinebi.
Iŋoji wareru Biŋe buŋo miko go eru garikiŋpugoji oi manesiŋ garu maŋyaŋuŋ kerisiebi sosowo munaŋ qa yareko qowirieinebi.’
“Sundu oi ba noreko nonji fuŋgaru Biŋe buŋo miboŋ. Oi mibe manebi Moro Tiriineji fuŋfuŋgaineo niŋore maŋgo rakaya, ore so kaje ruaru manebi yoŋore maŋgo oŋuakoŋ rakaya.
Iŋoji rakame ŋonebe oo akoŋ Ofonde buŋo mo nonde mamaneo wapeme manesuboŋ. Buŋo oi iŋi, ‘Jonji obu omaineji rau ŋareyayoŋ, nonji Moro Tiriine maŋ-ŋaŋuŋgo ruaru oiji rau ŋarebemiŋ.’

Niŋoji Ofoŋ Yesu Kristo manesiŋ gabeneŋ Anutuji yauŋine noreya, eru yoŋoji manesiŋ gabuŋ Anutuji yauŋine oi akoŋ yoŋore maŋgo oŋuakoŋ ruaya. Ore eru noŋ oŋuineji uruŋu Anutu usuŋ Rauine esoigaru igoga tenobo? Iŋoji oŋu eyareko nonji sabare teiŋgo embimbiŋgaboŋ.”

Pitaji sunduine oŋu miko maneru maŋyaŋuŋ munaŋgako waigo fukeko Anutu miteŋ gaku iŋi mibuŋ, “Fofori, niŋo maŋnoŋuŋ kerisieru gogo sanaŋinere biŋe fukegobeneŋ manegobeneŋyoŋ, Anutuji kadi moakoŋ oi kotu kantri ŋiŋigo yoŋore oŋuakoŋ rua yareko pega. Oi muŋambe yo mane taniŋgaru mane mukugobeneŋ.” Oŋu.
Kotu moreŋgo maŋkekerisie kubu fuŋfuŋgaine fukeya.

Stiwen qabi komeya ore eru sisikoŋkoŋ fukeko maŋkekerisie ŋiŋigoji roiŋgaru roregaru ra warebuŋ. Raru warebi goineji koe qaŋaŋineo Fonisia moreŋgo rabuŋ. Goineji koe petigaru nu tinaine Saiprus oo rabuŋ. Goineji Siria prowinsre siti tinaine Antiokia rabuŋ. Oŋu roiŋgaru rabuŋyoŋ, ŋiŋigo botuyaŋuŋgo Yesure Biŋe buŋo oi Juda ŋiŋigo akoŋ yajibi manebuŋ. Kotu kantri oi so yajibuŋ.

So yajibuŋyoŋ, Saiprus eru Sairini ŋi goineji yoŋore botugo gobuŋ. Yoŋoji kotu moreŋgo sogueru Antiokia sitio waperu moreŋ rauine yoŋoke Grik buŋoo mimane eku Ofoŋ Yesure Bobiaŋ Biŋe oi oŋu Juda mata yoŋore oŋuakoŋ mitaniŋga yarebuŋ.
Oi mitaniŋga yarebi Ofonji yoŋoke gome usuŋineji ŋiŋigo maŋyaŋuŋ bapakare yaberu kokoine yoŋoji Ofoŋ Yesu manesiŋ garu maŋyaŋuŋ kerisieru iŋoreo qakatobi kubuyaŋuŋ sogueru yasogo fukeya.
Oŋu fukeme ore biŋeji raru Jerusalem kufufuŋ yoŋore kajego rakame manebuŋ. Oi maneru Barnabas sorebi Antiokia sitio raya.
Raru roperu Anutuji yauŋmoririine ŋiŋigo yareme fiabuŋ, oi jiŋoineji ŋoneru maneko ropeme jerieru uŋsowoŋine iŋi miya, “Ŋoŋo sosowo maŋ-ŋaŋuŋ qojugaru sanaŋgaru Ofoŋke qakatoru dimainebi.”
Barnabasji ŋi fiine fukeko Moro Tiriineji maŋine puseko maŋyoka yoberu ŋadi gaku maŋine sosowo oiji Yesu manesiŋ gaku goya. Ore eru ŋiŋigo kokoineji maŋyaŋuŋ kerisieru Ofonde kubuo jikigabi sogueya.
Barnabasji Antiokia bokeru Sol baaiŋgo ore Tarsus taoŋgo raya.

Raru bofukeru ogame Antiokia sitio warebu. Wareru oo mokoyakuŋ gosa moakoŋ sosowo goku zioz gio baku maŋyaŋuŋ kerisiebuŋ, oi kubuine kubuine qaji yarebire ŋiŋigo kokoineji mamane roku maŋ wombuŋyaŋuŋgo ruabuŋ. Antiokia ŋiŋigoji fuŋfuŋgaine fuŋgaru kiŋariŋ tinayaŋuŋ Kristore ŋiŋigo (kristen, Kristore biŋe) miku gobuŋ. Oŋu.
Kotu kantrire maŋkekerisie yoŋoji Juda kitiŋ yabebuŋ.
Damaŋ oo kajeqouŋ ŋiŋigo goineji Jerusalem bokeru Antiokia sitio wakiru wapebuŋ.

Yoŋoreone mo tinaine Agabus oi pakereru Moro Tiriineji boburogame biŋe buŋo iŋi yajiya, “Roro yasogoji fukeru kaeine garebemiŋ sagaru peiŋ.” Oŋu miko ore so Sisa-kiŋ tinaine Klodius iŋore siŋaŋyayabe damaŋgo fukeya.
Oi fukeko kiŋariŋ yoŋoji qodureru maŋkekerisie ogopuyaŋuŋ Judia prowinsgo gobuŋ, oi kitiŋ yaberu qoqodure pesiŋ yasogo ruabi raiŋ ore buŋo kipebuŋ.
Buŋo oi kipebi eru ore so fofori ruabuŋ. Yoŋoji moneŋ eru ya qojugaru Barnabas Sol yokore meo ruaru sore yapebi Jerusalem raru maŋkekerisie kufufuŋ yoŋore minebobopu ŋone yaberu yarebu. Oŋu.
